liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Hell in a Bucket** (1 review): The opening song started shaky but ultimately pleased the listener [7]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Sugaree had a dependable beat and subtle Brent phrasings, though Jerry's voice was hoarse [7]
- **It Must Have Been the Roses** (1 review): Reviewers highlight impressive versions of Roses, To Lay Me Down, and Stella Blue [6]
- **Touch of Grey** (1 review): The review describes the performance of Touch of Grey as blazing [8]

## Setlist highlights

- **Happy Birthday Drummers**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [15]

## The recordings

- **gd88-04-11.sbd.bennett.10157.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 128 min; rated 3.67/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd1988-04-11.sbd.miller.91243.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 133 min; rated 2.6/5 by 5 [3]
- **gd1988-04-11.141859.sbd.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 20 songs; 134 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1988-04-11.141881.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 20 songs; 134 min [4]

## Around the show

- The venue is noted as the home of the Red Wings hockey team [6]
- This performance was the only time the band played at the Red Wings' home arena [8]
- The audience sang happy birthday to both drummers, though neither had a birthday that day [9]
- The reviewer notes seeing shows on both drummers' actual birthdays, May 9 and September 11 [11]
- The listener considered this one of the tightest shows among thirty-five attended over seven years [10]
- The performance was described as shaky with good playing but lacking overall cohesion [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd88-04-11.sbd.bennett.10157.sbeok.shnf**: source: reEAC, reshn of previous shn set (see info), via Jim Bennett [1]. Also: The recording lineage traces from SBD through FM broadcast, MC, and CDR transfers via Jim Bennett [1]
- **gd1988-04-11.sbd.miller.91243.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK SA-X90) D [3]. Also: Two different SBD cassette masters were used to complete the show, with the beginning missing [3]
- **gd1988-04-11.141859.sbd.miller.flac2496**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-R90) [2]
- **gd1988-04-11.141881.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-R90) [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead - 1988-04-11 Joe Louis Arena, Detroit, MI](https://thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com/2018/10/grateful-dead-1988-04-11-joe-louis.html) [16]
- Poster by theconcertdatabase.com: [The Grateful Dead | The Concert Database](https://theconcertdatabase.com/concerts/grateful-dead-17) [17]
